errors.url_format: URL must start with http:// or https:// and contain a host

meta.name: Meta & SEO Tags
meta.description: Checks title, meta description, canonical URL, og:image and H1 headings for correctness and completeness.

unavailable.name: Page metadata unavailable
unavailable.description: The page returned status {status, number}, so metadata could not be extracted.

missing_title.name: Missing title tag
missing_title.description: The page has no <title> tag. Search engines use the title as the primary clickable headline in SERPs.

title_too_short.name: Title tag too short
title_too_short.description: Title is only {length, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}. Short titles look thin in SERPs.

title_too_long.name: Title tag too long
title_too_long.description: Title is {length, number} characters — Google typically truncates after ~60 chars.
solutions: Trim the title to under 60 characters

missing_description.name: Missing meta description
missing_description.description: No meta description found. Google often uses it as the snippet in SERPs.

description_too_long.name: Meta description too long
description_too_long.description: Description is {length, number} characters. Google truncates around 160 chars.

missing_h1.name: Missing H1 heading
missing_h1.description: The page has no <h1> tag. H1 is a strong relevance signal.
solutions: Add exactly one <h1> that matches the topic

multiple_h1.name: Multiple H1 headings
multiple_h1.description: Found {count, plural, one {# H1 tag} other {# H1 tags}}. This can confuse crawlers.

missing_canonical.name: Missing canonical tag
missing_canonical.description: No canonical URL specified. Search engines may index duplicate URLs.

missing_og_image.name: Missing og:image
missing_og_image.description: No Open Graph image defined. Social shares will have no preview.

performance.name: Performance & HTTP
performance.description: Analyses server response time, HTTP status code and content type to surface basic performance and configuration issues.

slow_ttfb.name: Slow server response (TTFB)
slow_ttfb.description: Server responded in {ms, number}ms. Above 1500ms it can negatively affect rankings.

approaching_threshold.name: Response time approaching threshold
approaching_threshold.description: Server responded in {ms, number}ms. Monitor spikes over 1500ms.

non_200_status.name: Non-200 HTTP status
non_200_status.description: Status {status, number}. Search engines may not index non-200 pages.
